wsjHeadlines.title: Stock Market Today: CoreWeave Shares Jump 25%, Re-Energizing the AI Trade
wsjHeadlines.description: Cloud provider's latest update reassured investors; Nasdaq rises 2%

wsjHeadlines.title: CoreWeave Finds a Workaround to Capital Constraints—for Now
wsjHeadlines.description: The company’s ambitious plans will still require cooperation from capital markets.

wsjHeadlines.title: Hospital Stocks Are Feeling Blue, in a Good Way
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, CoreWeave’s mixed signal, and OpenAi’s mounting losses.

wsjHeadlines.title: Asian Bond Yields Rise on Growing Expectations for Fed Rate Hike
wsjHeadlines.description: Hotter-than-expected U.S. inflation data and Federal Reserve officials’ hawkish commentary raised the chances of a rate increase next month.

wsjHeadlines.title: The $26 Million Cyber Heist Rocking a Small New Jersey Town
wsjHeadlines.description: In historic Cranbury, residents are confronting local leaders over missing money that wasn’t disclosed until after the election.

wsjHeadlines.title: SEC Enforcement Penalties Fall to 18-Year Low
wsjHeadlines.description: The Wall Street regulator obtained about $1 billion last year, the lowest amount since the 2008 financial crisis.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.K. Police Arrested a U.S. Army Soldier on Allegations of Spying for Russia
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, Wall Street is worried about interest rates again, and Anthropic’s founders are about to be worth billions.

wsjHeadlines.title: A Reined In Jensen Huang Is Nvidia’s Best Option
wsjHeadlines.description: A more restrained chief would suit the chip giant well for the next phase of the AI boom.

wsjHeadlines.title: For Big Bank Stocks, Capitol Hill’s Bark Is Worse Than Its Bite
wsjHeadlines.description: Democrats’ election victory will put Wall Street critics in key seats, but the Fed holds the real power.

wsjHeadlines.title: DoorDash Shareholders Aren’t Convinced the Company Can Take On Amazon
wsjHeadlines.description: Following Instacart acquisition plans and an Amazon deal with rival Uber Eats, DoorDash stock is on sale.

wsjHeadlines.title: The Argument for Buying Treasury Bonds Is Still Strong
wsjHeadlines.description: As AI fears take down stocks, bonds offer compelling yields.

wsjHeadlines.title: How the Data Center Backlash Could Play Into the Hands of Big Tech
wsjHeadlines.description: Giants like Amazon and Microsoft stand to benefit from a shakeout.

wsjHeadlines.title: Wall Street Pay Set to Climb After Volatile Markets and IPOs Fuel Bank Profits
wsjHeadlines.description: Traders and investment bankers are set to see among the biggest bumps in bonuses.

wsjHeadlines.title: Financial Services Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on UniCredit, Credit Agricole, Banco BPM and more in the latest Market Talks covering Financial Services.

wsjHeadlines.title: Norway’s Oil Fund Reaches $224.5 Million Settlement With KPMG Over SVB Collapse
wsjHeadlines.description: Norges Bank Investment Management and co-lead plaintiff Sjunde AP-fonden, Sweden’s state pension fund, reached a $224.5 million settlement in principle.

wsjHeadlines.title: Paraguay’s President Resigns as Collapse of Bank With Close Ties to Him Sparks Crisis
wsjHeadlines.description: Santiago Peña’s downfall rattled a fast-growing South American economy that has attracted investors and forged close ties with the U.S.

wsjHeadlines.title: Goldman’s Exclusive Club of Partners Welcomes Its Biggest Class Since 2010
wsjHeadlines.description: In a shift from previous years, the bank didn’t provide a gender or racial breakdown of the class.

wsjHeadlines.title: Health Care Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on Novartis, GSK, Bayer and more in the latest Market Talks covering the Health Care sector.

wsjHeadlines.title: Auto & Transport Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on the U.S. barge fleet and more in the latest Market Talks covering the auto and transport sector.

wsjHeadlines.title: Tech, Media & Telecom Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on Anthropic, CoreWeave, TSMC and more in the latest Market Talks covering Technology, Media and Telecom.

wsjHeadlines.title: NYSE Affiliate to Launch 24/7 Tokenized Stock Trading This Month
wsjHeadlines.description: Eligible U.S. customers will be able to trade tokenized versions of more than 70 assets starting on Nov. 23, said Intercontinental Exchange and OKX’s joint venture OKXICE.

wsjHeadlines.title: Nasdaq-Backed Payward Launches Tokenized Versions of European Stocks
wsjHeadlines.description: The Nasdaq-backed company launched tokenized versions of more than 200 of the most-traded U.K. and European stocks.

wsjHeadlines.title: Nasdaq Jumps After CoreWeave Earnings
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stocks rose, led by the Nasdaq composite, after upbeat earnings from CoreWeave eased investors’ fears about the AI trade.

wsjHeadlines.title: European Chip Stocks Climb After CoreWeave Results Fuel AI Optimism
wsjHeadlines.description: Shares of European semiconductor companies were on the rise as solid results from cloud-computing company CoreWeave reignited AI appetite.

wsjHeadlines.title: Dangote Cement Shelves Secondary London Listing
wsjHeadlines.description: Nigerian-listed Dangote Cement dropped plans to pursue a secondary listing on the London Stock Exchange, citing current market conditions without elaborating.

wsjHeadlines.title: Tech, Media & Telecom Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on CoreWeave, Alphabet, Nvidia and more in the latest Market Talks covering Technology, Media and Telecom.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Stocks Slip on Inflation, AI Worries
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stocks fell after hotter-than-expected inflation data and a more modest valuation for one of the leading artificial-intelligence players.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Building Wealth Requires More Than Charity
wsjHeadlines.description: Handouts can’t scale to a whole nation. A market-based path to ownership can.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | The U.K. Aims Sanctions at Israel, Hits the Cayman Islands
wsjHeadlines.description: Measures against the Jewish state’s banks could damage the financial-services industry in the British territory.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Trump, the New Congress and the Solyndra Probe
wsjHeadlines.description: The administration’s equity stakes in U.S. companies are about to draw legislative scrutiny.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | There’s No Such Thing as a Stock-Market Bubble
wsjHeadlines.description: In 1999, just as today, when share prices fall, it isn’t a delusion correcting. It’s uncertainty resolving.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Politics Shakes Up the Markets
wsjHeadlines.description: A tech correction could force Washington to focus on the economy.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | The Virgin Islands in Crisis
wsjHeadlines.description: Restarting an idled oil refinery isn’t a cure-all for the territory’s financial woes.

wsjHeadlines.title: Poland’s Orlen Cancels Qatar LNG Supply Deal After Months of Force Majeure
wsjHeadlines.description: The termination of the long-term LNG supply contract with QatarEnergy marks the first-known cancellation of an agreement with the exporter since the Iran war began.

wsjHeadlines.title: Crude Futures Pick Up After Heavy Selling
wsjHeadlines.description: Oil futures picked up after sliding to two-month lows on optimism about a possible negotiated solution to the U.S.-Iran conflict.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Natural Gas Futures Continue to Climb
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. natural gas futures rose, with support from cooler near-term weather forecasts, high LNG feedgas flows and lower production.

wsjHeadlines.title: Gold’s Outlook Remains Compelling in Long Term k
wsjHeadlines.description: Gold was higher. Julius Baer said the metal remained compelling in the long term, and that inflationary pressure in the U.S. should ease next year, allowing the Fed to be less aggressive than currently feared.

wsjHeadlines.title: Basic Materials Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on gold futures, Barrick Mining, gold futures and more in the latest Market Talks covering Basic Materials.

wsjHeadlines.title: Dollar’s Strength Could Persist on U.S. Rate-Rise Prospects
wsjHeadlines.description: The dollar rose to a four-week high against a basket of currencies and ING said it was likely to remain firm in the near term on the prospect of the Federal Reserve raising interest rates.

wsjHeadlines.title: WSJ Dollar Index Rises 0.49% to 97.54
wsjHeadlines.description: The WSJ Dollar Index rose 0.5%, up three of the past four trading days.
